mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pisces_event_materialization (fact_kind, fact_id, experiment_id, group_id, event_type, materialization_source, replay_job_id, materialized_at) VALUES (#{entity.factKind}, #{entity.factId}, #{entity.experimentId}, #{entity.groupId}, #{entity.eventType}, #{entity.materializationSource}, #{entity.replayJobId}, #{entity.materializedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE experiment_id = VALUES(experiment_id), group_id = VALUES(group_id), event_type = VALUES(event_type), materialization_source = VALUES(materialization_source), replay_job_id = VALUES(replay_job_id), materialized_at = VALUES(materialized_at)
